issues.body: `phase_exit_failure` says a deliberate skip is a completed object, yet `_execute_defuse_actions` still continues on `snapshot != (action.head_sha, action.updated_at)` without incrementing `changed` or any separate completion count. The patch seeds/increments `attempted` for collection and revalidation deferrals, so a tick with one such deferral plus another candidate that revalidates cleanly to a skip has `attempted > 0`, `deferred` non-empty, and `changed == 0`; rule 2 therefore falsely reports that every defuse failed even though the skipped candidate completed successfully as a safe no-op. The new tests exercise deferrals alongside a successful mutation, not alongside a clean skip, so they do not catch this mixed case.
issues.fix_hint: Track completed no-ops separately from the defused-PR mutation census, or otherwise record a successful revalidation skip as completed phase work without inflating `defused_prs`. Add exact tests for both combinations requested previously: a collection deferral plus a different candidate's clean revalidation skip, and a revalidation-read deferral plus a different candidate's clean skip. Both should remain per-object alerts and must not produce a systemic phase failure.
issues.title: Deliberate defuse skips still do not satisfy phase completion accounting

verdict.summary: The round-three major remains. The new accounting records collection and revalidation failures, but it still does not count a clean revalidation skip as completed work. Consequently, a mixed tick containing one deferred candidate and one candidate safely revalidated away still satisfies `(attempted or deferred) and not changed` and is falsely reported as `every parked PR defuse failed`. The added tests cover deferral-only and deferral-plus-mutation cases, but not either mixed deferral-plus-skip case requested in round three. Because the same issue remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
